# Wise Business Plans

> > Professional business plan writing, financial forecasting, and strategic consulting for SBA loans, investors, grants, and business growth.

Wise Business Plans is a consulting firm specializing in custom business plans, financial projections, and strategic planning for entrepreneurs, startups, and established businesses seeking funding, loans, or strategic guidance. The firm serves diverse clients including SBA borrowers, venture investors, grant seekers, visa applicants, and corporate planners.

## Key Topics

- Business Plan Writing
- Financial Projections
- SBA Loans
- Investor Funding
- Market Research
- Business Valuation
- Financial Forecasting
- Capital Raising
- USDA Loans
- Strategic Planning
- Exit Planning
- M&A Strategy
- Grant Writing
- DSCR
- Startup Planning

## Core Business Planning Services

- [Professional Business Plan Writers & Consultants](https://wisebusinessplans.com): Homepage for Wise Business Plans' professional consulting services for SBA loans, investors, and immigration.
- [Startup Business Plans](https://wisebusinessplans.com/startup-business-plans): Custom startup business plans for investors, lenders, and E-2/L-1 visa compliance.
- [Strategic Business Plan](https://wisebusinessplans.com/strategic-business-plan): Strategic business planning with market research, SWOT analysis, and goal setting.
- [Corporate Business Plans](https://wisebusinessplans.com/corporate-business-plans): Corporate business plan writing aligning vision with investors and growth goals.

## Lending & Financing Solutions

- [SBA Business Plan Writing Services](https://wisebusinessplans.com/bank-business-plan): SBA business plan writing services meeting bank guidelines and lender underwriting requirements.
- [USDA Business Plan Consultant](https://wisebusinessplans.com/usda): USDA-compliant business plans for rural development loans and agricultural financing.
- [Financial Forecasting Services](https://wisebusinessplans.com/financial-forecasting): Financial forecasting and 3-5 year projections for funding, SBA loans, and growth.
- [Lease Commercial Space](https://wisebusinessplans.com/lease-commercial-space): Business plans for commercial lease applications and landlord approval.

## Capital Raising & Investment

- [Business Plan For Investors](https://wisebusinessplans.com/investor-business-plan): Investor-ready business plans designed for capital raising and venture funding.
- [Equity & Capital Strategy Planning](https://wisebusinessplans.com/equity-capital-strategy-planning): Equity strategy and capital planning for fundraising, dilution modeling, and M&A.
- [Business Valuation](https://wisebusinessplans.com/business-valuation): Business valuation using DCF, market comparable, and asset-based approaches.
- [Confidential Information Memorandum (CIM)](https://wisebusinessplans.com/confidential-information-memorandum): CIM preparation for company sales, capital raises, and mergers & acquisitions.

## Specialized Business Planning

- [International Business Plan Services](https://wisebusinessplans.com/international-business-plan): International business plans for global expansion and E-2 visa compliance.
- [Custom Franchise Business Plan Writing](https://wisebusinessplans.com/franchise-business-plan): Custom franchise business plans for franchisees with financial projections.
- [Merger and Acquisition Business Plan](https://wisebusinessplans.com/merger-and-acquisition-ma-business-plan): M&A business plans for mergers, acquisitions, and integration strategy.
- [Business Exit Planning & Business Strategy](https://wisebusinessplans.com/wise-exit-planning): Exit planning and ownership transition strategies for business succession.

## Grants, Proposals & Analysis

- [Grant Writing Business Plans](https://wisebusinessplans.com/grant-writing-business-plans): Grant writing and funder-ready business plans for nonprofits and U.S. businesses.
- [Business Proposal Writing Services](https://wisebusinessplans.com/business-proposal-writing-services): Professional business proposal writing for B2B, government, and investor deals.
- [Request for Proposal (RFP)](https://wisebusinessplans.com/request-for-proposal-rfp): RFP response writing for government contracts and competitive proposals.
- [Expert Feasibility Study Services](https://wisebusinessplans.com/feasibility-study): Feasibility studies analyzing business ideas with market research and financials.
